name: Inquisitor Web Spinner
body:
Web spinners appreciate a spider’s ability to construct the perfect snare to capture its prey. Web spinner magic enables these hunters to become silent ambushers, prepared to ensnare and dispatch enemies of the faith.

A web spinner has the following class features.

Special

A web spinner must select a deity that offers the artifice domain, or has one of the following as an area of concern: creation, craftsmanship, hunting, invention, nature, spiders, stealth, or wildlife.

Web Spinner (Ex)

At 1st level, a web spinner does not gain a domain.

Instead, she gains a bonus spell slot per spell level she can cast. The following spells must be prepared in her bonus spell slot: 1st—web bolt; 2nd—web shelter; 3rd— spider climb, communal; 4th—web cloud; 5th—vermin shape II; 6th—phantasmal web. At 3rd level, a web spinner gains the web monster special ability, usable two times per day. She gains 1 additional use of the web ability for every six levels beyond 3rd, to a maximum of four times per day at 15th level.

This replaces domain and the bonus teamwork feats gained at 3rd, 9th, and 15th level.

Perceptive Ambusher (Ex)

At 1st level, a web spinner gains a bonus equal to 1/2 her web spinner level on Perception skill checks made to locate traps and on Stealth checks as long as she doesn’t move more than 5 feet during her turn. Whenever she comes within 10 feet of a trap, the web spinner receives an immediate Perception skill check to notice the trap. This check should be made in secret by the GM.

This replaces stern gaze and discern lies.

Inured to Venom (Ex)

At 3rd level, a web spinner gains a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against poison. This bonus increases by +2 at 9th and 15th level. At 17th level, a web spinner is immune to poisons of all kinds.

This replaces solo tactics and slayer.

Arachnid Characteristics (Ex or Su)

At 6th, 12th, and 18th level, a web spinner chooses one of the ambulatory or sensory arachnid characteristics listed below. A characteristic can be chosen multiple times. Each characteristic grants an ability upon initial selection. If the ability is chosen more than once, the ability improves each additional time it is selected.

Motion Mastery: The first time this ability is chosen, a web spinner gains the ability to walk on walls (as though using the spell spider climb) for a number of rounds per day equal to her Wisdom modifier. This is a supernatural ability which does not require an action to activate. The rounds do not need to be used consecutively. The second time a web spinner selects this ability, she can use the ability for an additional number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 her inquisitor level. The third time a web spinner selects this ability, she adds her full inquisitor level instead.

Stealthy Survivalist: The first time this ability is chosen, a web spinner gains a +2 competence bonus on Stealth and Survival skill checks. Each additional time a web spinner selects this ability, the bonus increases by +2.

Vibrational Awareness: The first time this ability is chosen, a web spinner gains tremorsense out to 10 feet.

Each additional time a web spinner selects this ability, the range increases by +10 feet.

This replaces the teamwork feats gained at 6th, 12th, and 18th level.
